title: Dual extraction and reconciliation
description: Independently extract structured information, reconcile field-level differences, and lock the final dataset.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: dual-extraction-reconciliation
  title: Dual extraction and reconciliation
  description: Independently extract structured information, reconcile field-level differences, and lock the final dataset.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Create a validated structured dataset from a shared source.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 2
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - lock
  nodes:
    - id: source
      kind: input
      name: Source and extraction schema
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - schema
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: extract-a
      kind: agent
      name: Extraction pass A
      role: Independent data extractor
      prompt: Extract every requested field with source locations and nulls for unavailable data.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - extract
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: extract-b
      kind: agent
      name: Extraction pass B
      role: Independent data extractor
      prompt: Independently extract requested fields with source locations and nulls for unavailable data.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - extract
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: diff
      name: Field-level diff
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      role: Extraction reconciliation analyst
      prompt: Compare both extractions field by field. Preserve source locations and return agreed values, discrepancies, and
        unresolvedFields.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: reconcile
      kind: loop
      name: Reconcile extraction differences
      config:
        body:
          - extract-a
          - extract-b
          - diff
        exitCondition: diff.unresolvedFields == 0
        maxIterations: 2
        onExhausted: warn
    - id: lock
      kind: approval
      name: Data steward locks reconciled dataset
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Signed-off extraction dataset and discrepancy log
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: source
      to: extract-a
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: source
      to: extract-b
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: extract-a
      to: diff
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: extract-b
      to: diff
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: diff
      to: reconcile
      kind: control
      condition: failed
    - id: e6
      from: diff
      to: lock
      kind: control
      condition: passed
    - id: e7
      from: reconcile
      to: lock
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exhausted
    - id: e8
      from: lock
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
    - id: reconcile-exit
      from: reconcile
      to: lock
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
